name: China Masters
stakes: The China Masters offers a crucial opportunity for India's top shuttlers to consolidate their rankings and build momentum on the Super 750 stage following the intensity of the World Championships.
summary:
As the badminton world turns its attention to the ongoing BWF World Championships, India's contingent is already looking ahead to the China Masters, a Super 750 event kicking off in early September. While the draws for Shenzhen are yet to be revealed, the recent form and narratives from the Worlds will undoubtedly set the tone. All eyes are on the formidable Men's Doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, who are confident in their game and aiming for a strong showing.

In the singles, PV Sindhu continues her quest for a record sixth World Championships medal, carrying that ambition into the China Masters. She faces the perennial challenge of high expectations and tough draws, but her 'nothing to lose' mindset could prove a powerful asset. Lakshya Sen, another key singles player, is also attempting to script history and will be keen to build momentum from his Worlds campaign. Meanwhile, the Women's Doubles pair of Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand are continuing their rebuild after Treesa's ankle injury, hoping to find their rhythm and make a deep run in China.
